title: Local Limits of Preferential Attachment with Deterministic or Random Outdegree
statement: Do the local limits of affine preferential-attachment graphs with fixed outdegree agree with those of the corresponding Bernoulli preferential-attachment model with Poisson outdegree, after attachment is based only on indegree?
background:
